nodes.name: Feedback Webhook
nodes.notes: Entry point. POST JSON: {feedback, source?, request_id?}. Requires the X-Webhook-Secret header configured in the webhook Header Auth credential.

nodes.name: Gemini Classify
nodes.notes: LLM adapter. Provider-agnostic at the boundary: same shape (text in -> validated JSON out) works for the Claude adapter.

nodes.name: Validate LLM Output
nodes.notes: Second layer of defense: responseSchema enforcement is NOT enough; enums are re-checked here (models do drift).

nodes.name: Deterministic Routing
nodes.notes: The LLM proposes; THIS node disposes. Business rules live here only.

nodes.name: Prepare Escalation
nodes.notes: Side branch only. Escalation is opt-in via ESCALATION_WEBHOOK_URL and cannot change the triage response.

nodes.name: Notify Escalation

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ request_id: $json.request_id, routing_decision: $json.routing_decision, result: $json.result, source: $json.source, received_at: $json.received_at }) }}

nodes.notes: Fire-and-forget hand-off to the escalation workflow. A failure here never affects triage.

nodes.name: Prepare Audit Persist
nodes.notes: Side branch. Persists the audit row to the frontend review queue when AUDIT_WEBHOOK_URL is set.

nodes.name: Persist Audit
nodes.notes: Fire-and-forget audit persistence to /api/audit. Failures are logged, never surfaced to the caller.
